profile.headline: SDE at AWS Elemental
profile.summary:
I am an enthusiastic learner with an innovative spirit, who brings passion to all the work I do. My goal is to build technologies that create a better future for the world.

As a software engineer at AWS Elemental, I have worked with industry-leading software in video compression. I also have experience with web development, AI, digital logic, databases, cloud development, and operating systems through my time as a student at OSU.

I have years of experience working in teams at various different jobs, including software engineering, food service, and construction management. Everywhere I have been I have focused on making myself and those around me better.

I am driven to perform at the highest possible level, and am always willing to go the extra mile to ensure software I create is effective, efficient, and maintainable.

company.name: AWS Elemental, an Amazon Web Services Company

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on video encoding for the EVE team at AWS Elemental. Specifically, I improved the hierarchical pyramid search in the front end of the encoder. With the improvements, PSNR for motion compensated frames increased by roughly 10% on average across our sample set of video clips. To do this, I worked with C code as well as AVX2 vector code.
positions.insights: Skills: VTune · Git · Vector Code · Video Coding · C (Programming Language)

company.name: AWS Elemental, an Amazon Web Services Company

positions.title: Cashier, Greeter, Inside Expo, and Cook
positions.description: At Buffalo Wild Wings I juggled running food, seating hundreds of people, and taking dozens of call-in orders simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. I also handled hundreds of orders per night rapidly and with accuracy in the kitchen, while making sure to uphold cleanliness standards beyond what was required.

positions.title: Assitant Project Engineer
positions.description: I was an assistant project engineer, meaning I primarily dealt with the paperwork side of construction work. This included updating submittal logs that contained over 100 submittals, creating a master list of operations and maintenance manuals for the $18.6 million project, updating organization systems, and ordering labels for various parts. My main duty was to help get the work done that was necessary for construction workers to be able to carry out their work.

positions.title: Restaurant Crew Member
positions.description: Worked on counter duty to take orders from customers. This involved collaborating with fellow team members to correctly serve hundreds of orders per day. I also had to manage the register so that change was accurately given and hundreds of dollars remained accounted for to the penny. Lastly, I was in charge of general maintenance of the restaurant and it's restrooms, often staying late to achieve a through clean. All of this was done in a fast-paced environment where customers get angry if something is done incorrectly.

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: I have been a member of the Dean's List at Oregon State University for every term I have been there.

volunteerExperiences.description: For VedderTang Tutoring I tutored refugee students in subjects such as English, Math, Spanish, and Computer Science. This involved working through language barriers and developing a connection with the students to help them better. Through tutoring I was able to gain an improved handle on the subject matter myself.

Through a club at my high school, I volunteered for the National Honor Society in multiple projects. Examples of these include bark chipping a local park, bagging food for homeless shelters, and cleaning out weeds from another local park.

projects.title: Computer Graphics Shader Exploration
projects.description: This project was an exploration of shaders done in my computer graphics class. The linked video demonstrates the result of the project. The ridges in the sphere are created using the vertex shader, while the orangish sphere pattern on the sphere is created using the fragment shader. Both are animated with respect to time.

projects.title: Classroom API
projects.description: This project creates an API that might be used in a classroom setting. There are assignments, courses, and users, each of which have many associated endpoints. These endpoints can be found in the linked GitHub repository inside the "postman" folder. This project involved endpoint generation, asynchronous jobs, file handling, and database management.
